assembly_sequence.candidate_connector_transport: two separate removable timber cleats per side; keep each cleat and its bolts removable
assembly_sequence.floor_sequence: Preassemble and torque accessible center connections on stable raised supports before setting the frame at the floor; verify the active backer bottom-seat insertion sweep and real tool swing first. Nominal model does not qualify supports, clearances, or a floor anchor.
assembly_sequence.tool_access_basis: 25.4 mm diameter by 50 mm axial cylinder is a clearance proxy, not a wrench swing or selected product

one_piece_C_saddle.reason: A continuous one-piece rear saddle needs a stock envelope spanning separated principal and moved-post interfaces; the obvious backstrap exceeds ordinary 4x6 width and front-face through-bolts would need a separate panel-plane/tool-access design. No custom or built-up stock is assumed.

right_upper_principal_header_cleat.nominal_stock: ordinary full-section 4x4 solid timber, grain parallel to center principal T
